place._theme: A built site somebody works: there are stores to lock people in.

prose.briefing: A Spacer crew has come down near the <Place>, and they are on their way in armed. The supervisor there has locked her night shift in the stores and wants someone to meet the crew before they reach the door.

beats.objective: Defeat the Spacer captain at the <Place>
beats.journal: The Spacer captain at the <Place> is dead and her crew have scattered. The night shift can come out of the stores.
say: Their captain's down? Then I'm unlocking the stores, and nobody goes back to work until I've counted heads.

broadcast: A crew's come down near us, armed, and they're on their way in. I've locked the night shift in the stores. If that crew reaches the door, it's the night shift who pay for it, so get here first.
